full_judgment:
11. PW 1, the informant of this case was found to have made out the first information report case in toto. He said about calling of the deceased by accused Md Abdul Baten on the date together with his information regarding murder of the deceased on the following day. He further claimed that on hearing of the same he rushed to the place of occurrence house and found accused Abdul Baten in tied condition and the dead body of deceased on the cot in the room of accused Alamgir Hossain with various injuries on his body. This PW also claimed that accused Abdul Baten allegedly reported him in presence of others that he (Baten), Mostaq, Alamgir, Nobab Ali, Foolbabu and Hamid have murdered the deceased and accordingly, he lodged the first information report. He proved the first information report and his signature thereto Exhibits 1 and 1/1 respectively. This PW, in cross, claimed that in all four co-sharers, namely, Alamgir, Abdul Karim, Abdul Malek and Jahangir used to reside in the PW house. He further said that the deceased was a contractor and failed to state the amount of money so given by the deceased to others for business purpose. He claimed to have seen accused Abdul Baten to go with the deceased on the date and admitted that he has no paper to show that accused Abdul Baten took loan from the deceased. He admitted that he found marks of blood on the floor as well as wall of the place of occurrence room. He admitted that accused Abdul Baten married the sister of accused Alamgir Hossain. He further claimed that he made a GD entry over the 'occurrence prior to the first information report so lodged by him. He denied the defence suggestion that the deceased had enmity with other contractors and that the deceased did not go with accused Abdul Baten and stayed in the house of accused Alamgir Hossain as alleged. He further denied that the accused are not responsible for murder of the deceased. 

 12. PW 2 Abul Kashem claimed that he found the deceased with accused Abdul Baten in front of Ulipur Cinema Hall in the evening of 14-5-1997. He further claimed that accused Abdul Baten and deceased went away there from in a rickshaw and he came to know on the following day from the informant of this case that the deceased had been murdered. He further claimed to have accompanied the informant to the place of occurrence house and found accused Abdul Baten in tied condition there. This PW further said about extra-judicial confession so made by accused Abdul Baten implicating himself along with accused Alamgir, Mostaq and Nobab Ali. In cross, he claimed that he reported' to the informant of this case about seeing the deceased with accused Abdul Baten in a rickshaw on the date of occurrence prior to lodging of first information report. He denied, the defence suggestion that he did not see accused Abdul Baten with the deceased in a same rickshaw on the date of occurrence as alleged. He further denied that accused Abdul Baten was apprehended by the villagers out of suspicion inasmuch as he was not connected with the murder of the deceased.
